source_questions.original_text: 7. Identify three functions of the control unit (CU) in the central processing unit (CPU). [3]
source_questions.parent_context: 7. Identify three functions of the control unit (CU) in the central processing unit (CPU). [3]

assets.description: SL source page independently read; duplicate wording/marks verified against actual SL paper and markscheme.

assessed_concepts: Describe the functions and interactions of the main CPU components.

markscheme.marking_summary: Fetch/decode instructions, control data movement, generate control signals/synchronize operations.

mappings.scope_evidence:
• Units: arithmetic logic unit (ALU), control unit (CU)
• Registers: instruction register (IR), program counter (PC), memory address register (MAR), memory data register (MDR), accumulator (AC)
• Buses: address, data, control
• Processors: single core processor, multi-core processor, co-processors
• A diagrammatic representation of the relationship between the specified CPU components
mappings.rationale: CU functions are expressly within CPU components.
